nodes.text: Let $t>1$ be a rational number. Is\[\sum_{n=1}^\infty\frac{1}{t^n-1}=\sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{\tau(n)}{t^n}\]irrational, where $\tau(n)$ counts the divisors of $n$?

#1049 : [Er88c,p.102] irrationality A conjecture of Chowla. Erdős [Er48] proved that this is true if $t\geq 2$ is an integer.
